content.text: The evidence is clear: the flag toggle at 07:00:00 (logs show flag flipping from off to on, gradually rolling out 68/132 then fully on) directly correlates with ZeroDivisionError exceptions starting exactly then, causing the error rate spike from ~1% to ~30%+. The change log confirms the flag toggle at 07:05:19Z (though logs show it started rolling out earlier, around 07:00:00).

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The monthly-spend-feature flag was toggled from off to on, and the newly-enabled code path in spend_summary.py has a bug that divides by zero, causing account page requests to fail. Error rate jumped from ~1% baseline to 23-34% exactly as the flag rolled out from off to on.

supporting_evidence.claim: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47
account page error rate at 34.00% over the last minute
feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on
error_rate rose from 0.01 baseline to 0.23 at 07:00:00Z and to 0.34 by 07:05:00Z
